items.condition: Confusing ring and butyl coupling, wrong isotope/sign convention, missing butyl groups, falsely labeling a basis-only calculation relativistic, or comparing unrelated conformer identities invalidates the affected result.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A correlation of coupling with one orbital descriptor is not a causal decomposition. A ZORA-compatible basis name does not establish that the Hamiltonian included ZORA. Empirical source scaling cannot be treated as a universal physical correction without calibration.
